name: CLIENT_ID
label: OAuth client ID
help: For GitHub Enterprise Server, register the OAuth App on your instance and configure GITHUB_URL on the worker.
setupSteps: In GitHub Developer settings, create a new OAuth App (an OAuth App, not a GitHub App — GitHub Apps ignore OAuth scopes).
Set the Homepage URL to your instance URL, and the Authorization callback URL to the redirect URI below.
Register the application, then generate a new client secret.
Copy the Client ID and client secret here.
